name: rp1_l2wp_l3wpbal

command: f4_g4ab.py rp1_l2wp_l3wpbal /srv/opentallas-scratch2/claude/wt/qc-su-f4-2-1026/results/qc_su_f4/r1/rp1_f4a.geo 6 /srv/opentallas-scratch2/claude/master-plan-r4-1026/su_refloor /srv/opentallas-scratch2/claude/wt/qc-su-f4-2-1026/results/master_plan_r5/su_unequal/su_tree_uf.py /srv/opentallas-scratch2/claude/wt/qc-su-f4-2-1026/physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2_col combos/rp1_l2wp_l3wpbal --l2 wp --l3 wp --wp-key bal

model.form: uf_asbuilt (sum-of-branch loads, Elmore per branch, leaf MST) + rise/fall chains; NLDM + setRC 0.8/0.9

model.unabsorbed_residual: prog as-built residual TT -16.6 sd3.6 / FF -11.8 sd2.9 (KITS-2 r2) NOT applied

entry_trunk.objective: min max(|TT avg mean-250|, |FF early mean-202.5|), offsets applied; 12.8c/d1 plan-computed
